name: @themusicdev/env-sync
description: Sync a monorepo root .env into per-app .env files declared by .env.example mapping headers
author: Angel S. Moreno

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/index.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');let s=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.js','utf8').replace(/^#!.*\n/,'');fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.js','#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+s)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun test && bun run check:types && bun run build
